entries.title: Iran Shuts Down Major Websites and Https Protocol
entries.author: Sara70
entries.current_title: Iran Shuts Down Major Websites and Https Protocol
entries.excerpt: I'm writing this to report the serious troubles we have regarding accessing Internet in Iran at the moment. Since Thursday Iranian government has shutted down the https protocol which has caused almost all google services (gmail, and google.com itself) to become inaccessible. Almost all websites that reply on Google APIs (like wolfram alpha) won't work. Accessing to any website that replies on https (just imaging how many websites use this protocol, from Arch Wiki to bank web
entries.guide_zh: 伊朗用户报告主要网站及 HTTPS 访问受阻，描述当时的上网困境。

entries.title: We're turning off Clickpass March 15. How to keep your HN account.
entries.author: pg
entries.current_title: We're turning off Clickpass March 15. How to keep your HN account.
entries.excerpt: We're going to stop supporting Clickpass on March 15. If you use Clickpass to log in to Hacker News, please (1) put your email address in your profile (no one can see it except you and us), then (2) change your password by going to http://news.ycombinator.com/changepw.
entries.guide_zh: Clickpass 登录支持即将停用，HN 提醒相关用户处理邮箱和账号。

entries.guide_zh: 有经验的程序员转向 JavaScript，想了解框架之外还需要哪些开发工具。

entries.title: Ask HN: How to move away from Gmail
entries.author: AmazingWill
entries.current_title: Ask HN: How to move away from Gmail
entries.excerpt: I'm currently attempting to move away from Gmail to a email provider that respects my privacy. Can anyone on HN suggest a online service that protects my privacy, has IMAP support and is preferably free? In addition is it possible to delete most of the data Google currently ties to my profile?
